_comment: Synthetic settled Kalshi tennis markets with public-tape-shaped trades (t, s=taker_side, p=yes_price, c=count). Whale-class prints (>=1000 contracts) buy the eventual winner ~80% of the time; retail longshot prints buy the loser ~96% of the time (below the price they pay). Exercises research.whale_noise.whale_flow_expost; not evidence about Kalshi.
